title: nb: an empty CLAUDECODE= counts as the user
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

SPEC (Authorship): author is `claude` when the environment has `CLAUDECODE` set.

`bin/nb` line 203 tests truthiness, so `CLAUDECODE= nb add goal G` is authored by the user. The gate hook does prompt for that form, so this is a second line of defence only.
